description: Dialogue-capable multilingual TTS: Bailing-MoE-V3 backbone (7.9B total / 1.3B active), flow-matching head, audio VAE, CAMPPlus conditioning. Adds the upstream multi-speaker podcast task.

request.name: template_name
request.description: Upstream task mode. podcast is the only multi-speaker mode.

request.name: language
request.description: Target language name or code.

request.name: instruct
request.description: Voice description for voice_design, raw instruction for freeform, optional conditioning for tts. Upstream names this field instruction.

request.name: emotion
request.description: Emotion label for the emotion template.

request.name: dialect
request.description: Dialect for the dialect template.

request.name: speed
request.description: Categorical speaking speed for the basic template.

request.name: pitch
request.description: Categorical pitch for the basic template.

request.name: volume
request.description: Categorical volume for the basic template.

request.name: voice_id
request.description: Built-in voice for the ip template.

request.name: reference_text
request.description: Transcript accompanying reference audio. For podcast this is the tagged multi-speaker transcript.

request.name: voice_samples
request.description: Podcast references, positional: one wav per speaker.

request.name: use_speaker_embedding
request.description: Condition on the reference speaker embedding.

request.name: zero_speaker_embedding
request.description: Use a zero projected speaker row instead of reference conditioning.

request.name: max_tokens
request.description: Duration cap: maximum generated acoustic patches. Mirrors the checkpoint's maximum_decode_steps (default 250 patches = 20.0 s at 12.5 patches/s). The checkpoint has no end-of-sentence decision (old_shift decode), so this is the only length control; shorter renders are explicit caps.

request.name: guidance_scale
request.description: Flow guidance scale.

request.name: sigma
request.description: Flow SDE noise scale.

request.name: temperature
request.description: Flow sampling temperature.

request.name: flow_steps
request.description: Euler steps for the flow head.

request.name: seed
request.description: Reference-posterior and generation noise seed. The podcast template uses 1235.

request.name: raw_text
request.description: Send the text as one fragment without frontend chunking. Must stay off for podcast.

request.name: text_chunk_size
request.description: Framework long-form chunk budget in Unicode codepoints.

request.name: text_chunk_mode
request.description: Framework text chunking policy.

request.name: trim_silence
request.description: Trim trailing low-energy frames per fragment.

session.name: reference_cache
session.description: Reuse prepared conditioning for the most recent reference set.

session.name: parity
session.description: Numerics profile: reference pins SDPA attention and the non-fused KDA recurrence.
